description: List a tracked profile's persisted posts with full metrics and text — query against the local post library, no LinkedIn pull, free. Use this when the caller already has a profile_id and wants to read its posts. Filter by date range, post type, minimum engagement, or text. Pass `scope` (a post_collections.id) to restrict to a specific collection (e.g. an external profile, topic stream, or hand-curated set). Paginated. For keyword/semantic search across posts, use `search_posts`. For fresh LinkedIn pulls, use `linkedin_profile_posts`.

scope.description: Optional post_collections.id to filter posts to a specific collection

name: get_posts
title: Get Posts
